picks.title: AI-supported first consultation preparation in oncology: a real-world clinical usability study
picks.excerpt: Real-world oncology clinic study of AI-based First Consultation Preparation (AI-FCP), an LLM that turns unstructured referral documents into structured summaries before a patient's first oncology visit, measuring workflow performance and clinician usability.
picks.rationale: This is the freshest item in the pool, and the open-access body can be fetched. An LLM deployed in a live oncology clinic turns messy referral packets into structured summaries before a new patient's first visit, and the study measures clinician usability.

picks.title: Artificial intelligence for opportunistic osteoporosis screening on chest radiographs
picks.excerpt: AI-OsRM predicts osteoporosis and low bone mineral density from routine chest X-rays; trained on 46,478 paired CXR/DXA exams from 26,757 patients and tested for clinical utility in three external cohorts.
picks.rationale: The model screens for osteoporosis on chest X-rays patients already get, so an underdiagnosed disease is caught without an extra DXA scan. It was trained on 46k paired exams and validated in three external cohorts.

picks.title: Keeping artificial intelligence agents within the clinical task
picks.excerpt: Lancet Digital Health comment: general-purpose AI agents (ChatGPT Work, Codex, Claude Cowork, Claude Code) can now operate files and applications on clinicians' computers; the authors argue how to keep them scoped to the clinical task.
picks.rationale: General-purpose desktop agents can now act on clinicians' machines, and this Lancet Digital Health comment sets out how to keep them scoped to the clinical task. It complements, but does not repeat, the AMA governance framework published 10-16.

picks.title: Public Perceptions of Timeliness for AI Use and Human Oversight
picks.excerpt: Cross-sectional JAMA Network Open study of how patients across birth generations weigh faster AI answers against waiting for human review in patient-portal messaging and mental health support; published with an invited commentary on 'waiting for the human in the loop'. (Date verified via Crossref.)
picks.rationale: Patients weigh a fast AI answer against waiting for a human to review it, in portal messages and mental-health support. That is a direct design input for any health system putting AI drafting into patient messaging.

alternates.title: PocketHealth expands agentic AI platform
alternates.excerpt: PocketHealth is extending its Conductor agentic AI platform into radiology protocoling, the reading room and revenue cycle, operating API-less legacy apps and payer portals under audited least-privilege accounts.
alternates.rationale: The body can be fetched and AI is central, but this is a vendor product expansion, mostly operational and revenue cycle. Use it if the auscultation abstract cannot be retrieved.

alternates.title: Voice AI startup careCycle rolls out free plan comparison tool for Medicare beneficiaries
alternates.excerpt: CareCycle, a voice AI company serving Medicare agencies, launched a free tool that helps Medicare beneficiaries compare plans; it takes no payer payments or commissions and does not sell personal data.
alternates.rationale: It reaches patients and has a real image, but the clinical tie is weak because this is a plan-comparison tool. Second alternate.
